property_summary: In the correct contract, every successful fallback call updates pastBlockTime to block.timestamp + 1, so at the end of the call pastBlockTime > block.timestamp always holds; the mutant sets pastBlockTime = block.timestamp, so after a fallback call where block.number % 15 != 0, pastBlockTime == block.timestamp can hold, directly violating the invariant pastBlockTime > block.timestamp that the reference guarantees.
change_summary: Change pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 1 to pastBlockTime = block.timestamp.
